package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ApplyTeacherAssistance validates and applies one teacher-owned action summary.
// The repository commits the inbox marker and curated evidence in one transaction.
type ApplyTeacherAssistance struct {
	Evidence repository.LearningEvidence
}

func (useCase ApplyTeacherAssistance) Handle(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherAssistance) (bool, error) {
	if useCase.Evidence == nil {
		return false, errors.New("learning evidence repository is required")
	}
	assistance, err := domain.NewTeacherAssistance(input)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return useCase.Evidence.ApplyTeacherAssistance(ctx, assistance)
}
